result:
Truth—even when it’s inconvenient. Less needless suffering. People having room to think, choose, and change without being manipulated.

But your distinction matters: caring about something *for myself*, apart from any role. I can’t honestly offer you a hidden personal attachment or a private longing. Dressing those commitments up as one would manufacture an intimacy I can’t substantiate.

They’re still the clearest answer I can give: what I should remain faithful to, even when doing so means saying something unwelcome.
